column1: # Covers: Mexican-origin / Mexican-headquartered brands: beer, tequila, mezcal and other spirits, soft drinks,
# packaged food, snacks and candy (Bimbo, Barcel, Gamesa, Sabritas, De la Rosa ...), dairy, restaurants and
# chains, retailers, banks and financial services, telecom, media and newspapers, airlines, conglomerates and
# industrial companies, cement and construction, pharma and personal care, fashion and footwear, hotels and
# resorts, cinemas and entertainment, Liga MX and Liga de Expansión football clubs, carmakers, apps.
# Sources: Wikipedia "List of companies of Mexico", "Category:Brands of Mexico", "Category:Tequila brands",
# "List of mezcal brands", BMV IPC / BMV listings, Liga MX club list, Kantar/Brand Finance Mexico lists; Korean
# news for established spellings (코로나, 멕시코, 텔셀, 아에로멕시코, 시멕스 ...); otherwise 스페인어 외래어 표기법.
